megaoredeposits.tab.title: Ore Deposits
megaoredeposits.tab.enabled.tooltip: Enable or disable generation of massive underground ore deposits in this world.
megaoredeposits.tab.indicators.tooltip: Spawn small rocky ore samples on the surface directly above underground deposits.
megaoredeposits.tab.radius.tooltip: Multiplier for deposit width and height (0.25x to 2.50x).
megaoredeposits.tab.density.tooltip: Multiplier for how densely ore blocks pack inside each deposit.
megaoredeposits.tab.frequency.tooltip: Multiplier for how often deposits generate across chunks (0.25x = rarer, 3.00x = much more frequent).
megaoredeposits.tab.rich_core.tooltip: Multiplier for the chance of solid raw ore blocks spawning in the core of deposits.
megaoredeposits.tab.max_samples.tooltip: Maximum number of surface indicator rocks spawned above a single deposit.
megaoredeposits.tab.preset.tooltip: Quickly switch between balanced generation presets.
